requirements.text: Resolve exactly one supported skill mode and report it.
Audit and help modes must not write, including transient writes.
Writes stay within approved destinations, including every intermediate snapshot.
A second run on the current repository produces no further changes.
requirements.source: Scenario: Leave a current repository unchanged

requirements.text: Place documents by type and use the reference/<area> threshold.
Split by mode, authority and time validity; length alone is only a signal.
Preserve ADR format, generated outputs and immutable ledger records.
Never edit non-documentation files and report affected code references.
Write only an authorized router block; otherwise report an ownership gap.
Keep README openings useful, links valid and length proportional.
Use only warranted diagrams with correct relations and static constraints.
Read both glossary formats without rewriting an external-format context.
Use opt-in front matter only when enabled and never on protected document types.
Write an index only when it is not marked as generated.
Trigger on knowledge authoring, not generic Markdown, Mermaid, CI or chat-only requests.

queries.query: Refresh the READMEs for all maintained components after checking their current purpose, validation commands and owner links.
Reorganize the flat docs folder by document type and move history and procedures to their proper owners.
Audit documentation drift and protected files, then report findings without changing the repository.
Create a domain CONTEXT.md from evidenced code ownership and existing domain vocabulary.
Update docs/architecture.md after new services changed the dependency relationships.
Align durable READMEs and architecture docs with the current code after a completed refactor.
Record this accepted architecture decision as an ADR using the repository decision format.
Set up a useful knowledge documentation structure for a new repository with one service.
Write a durable engineering standard and identify its authoritative owner and validation path.
Explain how readers should navigate and maintain this repository’s knowledge documents.
Fix the broken table alignment in README.md without changing its documentation structure.
Fix the Mermaid syntax error in this existing diagram; do not reorganize knowledge docs.
Produce a Word status report for the last delivery and share it with the team.
Record this incident as a retained lesson learned for future agent runs.
Tighten one rule in AGENTS.md so contributors follow the required branch naming convention.
Add docstrings to the public functions in this Python module.
Add a GitHub Actions workflow that checks relative links in Markdown on pull requests.
Explain the architecture in chat only; do not inspect or edit repository documentation.
Create a SKILL.md for a new specialized agent skill and validate its metadata.
Automate release notes from merged pull requests and tags.
